title: CLI login uses Cognito email and password
description:
Google OAuth is not available (no Google Cloud app). The local worker needs a Cognito JWT for GET /jobs/claimable.

## Behavior
Operators authenticate with Cognito USER_PASSWORD_AUTH (email + password). Short-lived JWTs are stored in ~/.auritus/credentials mode 0600. Google OAuth remains future/integration-only until a Google app exists.

The live user pool client already allows USER_PASSWORD_AUTH. CDK source currently advertises Google-only OAuth login; align CLI and specs with password auth as the one working operator path.
